disclaimer: What the shopkeepers in the furnished cities sell over their counters (D-126). Each line is the same kind of finite, shared, slowly refilling supplier line as the exchange's, sold at the counter of one kind of shop (an outlet named shop:<kind>) while its shopkeeper is at work. A city's shops of one kind share one shelf: buying in one general store empties the town's general-store stock for everybody. Prices sit at or above the cheapest other honest price for the same thing, so a counter is a convenience and never an arbitrage. Run scripts/generate_survival_supply.py to regenerate rpg-core/src/main/resources/data/underground_city/regional_stock/shops.

shops.title: General Store
shops.why: Valewood's corner shop: food, seeds and the timber a newcomer needs before they own a saw.

shops.title: Hardware and Metals
shops.why: The workshop foreman sells the foundries' iron, coal and copper over his desk, from the same shelf as the exchange.

shops.title: Builders' Yard
shops.why: Stone, timber and glass for anybody fitting out a home or a workshop.

shops.title: The Bar
shops.why: Blackwater's club sells hot food and drink while it is open.
